0x0007EC.en: 「With what I've got now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008E5.en: 「Dammit! @　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A0E.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000A46.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000B0F.en: 「Tch! So this is where it ends...!」

0x000B4A.en: 「I'm not going down here...!@　This ain't fun...」

0x000B9E.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000CEF.en: 「This is the end... I leave the rest to you.」

0x000D9B.en: 「No good, took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000DE8.en: 「Well, that's a shame. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E26.en: 「Kyaah, I leave the rest to you!」

0x000E6D.en: 「The Granzon... shot down, of all things...」

0x000F18.en: 「Ugh... So I'm going down like a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x000F97.en: 「T-this is as far as I can go...!」

0x000FCF.en: 「Ow ow ow... I give up. Guess I miscalculated.」

0x001010.en: 「Well now, they've gone and got me!」

0x0010C1.en: 「Ugh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001108.en: 「I'm sorry, I leave the rest to you.」

0x001181.en: 「I can't take any more! Pulling back!」

0x001229.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ How green of me...!」

0x001277.en: 「No good, I can't hold out! Falling back!」

0x001332.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x001361.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x00139F.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x0013CE.en: 「I can't go on. If you'll excuse me.」

0x001459.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x001965.en: 「Captain, Masaki says he'll guide us...@ Are we sure that's a good idea?」

0x0019EC.en: 「Quit yer griping. The Solatis Temple's that way, that way.」

0x001A75.en: 「What're you talking about, it's that way.」

0x001AB0.en: 「...No question, Masaki's the wrong one, nya.」

0x001AF4.en: 「Yeah, we're better off trusting Torres, nya.」

0x001B47.en: 「I'll give the directions to the helmsman myself.@ Is that all right, Captain?」

0x001BF6.en: 「Can't be helped, given how things have gone so far, nya.」

0x001C46.en: 「To get to see Kuro and Shiro@ up this close... I'm so moved...!」

0x001CC4.en: 「I'm Azuki Sawa.@ I was originally on the second bridge, but@ I've been reassigned to the first bridge.」

0x001D67.en: 「Meaning she's my junior. Nice to have you.」

0x001DD5.en: 「U-um... may I touch your paw pads?」

0x001E31.en: 「Then, don't mind if I do.@ ...Wow, so squishy!@ Squish squish squish squish!」

0x001F08.en: 「Yes!@ Which is why I'm so, so jealous of you, Masaki.」

0x001F5E.en: 「Well, when you've got time to kill,@ feel free to keep these two company.」

0x001FDC.en: 「...Keeping cats company is fine and all,@ but the internal call lamp's been blinking for a while now.」

0x00206C.en: 「Heh, listen to you playing the senior.」

0x00209D.en: 「Well, I am the senior. And you've got a cute junior of your own now, right? Mio.」

0x002121.en: 「Gathering intel quickly comes with the job.」

0x002164.en: 「...Captain,@ a message from the third medical room.@ That boy has woken up.」

0x0021F1.en: 「Understood. Tell them I'm on my way.」

0x0022A1.en: 「Yes.@ He can converse and has general knowledge,@ but about himself, all he remembers is his name...」

0x0023A8.en: 「...I'm the captain of this battleship Hagane,@ Lieutenant Commander Tetsuya Onodera.」

0x002401.en: 「...So you're the one.@ Thank you for saving me.」

0x002466.en: 「You were in a damaged mobile weapon's escape pod@ - likely shot down after a fight with someone.@ Does that ring a bell?」

0x00253E.en: 「...No.@ Who I am, where I came from, what I was doing...@ I don't remember any of it.」

0x0025D2.en: (From the look of him,@ I don't think he's lying, but...)

0x00262B.en: 「...Rio,@ stay with the security detail and keep an eye on him.」

0x00268B.en: 「Doctor, Ryoto, step outside. We need to talk.」

0x0026F1.en: 「...A pilot at that age?@ First thought: the <Boosted Children>.@ Could he be under mental manipulation - a <Remote Control>?」

0x0027D0.en: 「I've scanned his brain several times,@ but there's no sign of any <Remote Control>.」

0x00283D.en: 「There's a contusion on his head, but... it doesn't look traumatic.@ More like psychogenic retrograde amnesia.」

0x0028DC.en: 「Nothing notable there either.@ We also ran a TPL test just in case,@ and the result was negative.」

0x0029A0.en: 「You're saying he's just an ordinary human?」

0x0029D4.en: 「That's not quite the right way to put it.@ There were signs he'd undergone@ combat and pilot training.」

0x002A67.en: 「So it's all but certain@ he's a pilot.」

0x002AC3.en: 「Ryoto,@ what did the analysis of his escape pod turn up?」

0x002B16.en: 「We couldn't identify the model or manufacturer.@ Similar cases would be the machines the <Shadow Mirror> used,@ and also...」

0x002BD5.en: 「the Excellences that Raul and the others used...」

0x002C34.en: 「So it came from a parallel world?」

0x002C7A.en: 「Or possibly somewhere unconnected to the Federation,@ <Mao Industry>, or <Isurugi Heavy Industries>...@ Somewhere like GS, for instance.」

0x002D57.en: 「That place is independent of the Federation too,@ developing and testing its own new weapons, right?」

0x002DE7.en: 「Yeah, Grand Christmas...@ It used to be called <Aidoneus Island>.」

0x002E5D.en: 「The surrounding waters are sealed off, and@ the whole island's covered by a special shade,@ invisible even to Satellite Seekers, they say.」

0x002F08.en: 「I don't know the details either, but...@ despite being a body under the President's direct command,@ there are a lot of shady rumors.」

0x002F89.en: 「Even if we wanted to look into Ing's connection to it,@ there's nothing we can do from <La Gias>...」

0x002FFF.en: 「True.@ ...Doctor, alongside his treatment, try to help him@ recover his memory. But don't use any forceful methods.」

0x0030A4.en: 「Understood, but@ please keep the surveillance tight as well.」

0x0030F7.en: 「Right. I'll keep a security detail on him at all times.」

0x003134.en: 「Captain, a message from the bridge.@ We'll reach the Solatis Temple in about 20 minutes.」

0x0031B7.en: 「Understood. I'm heading back to the bridge.」

0x0031E2.en: 「Hey, old lady Ybun!@ You're in there, right? It's me, Masaki!」

0x00325A.en: 「Weird. Usually the priests are around here by now...」

0x0032A0.en: 「!? Something's coming out of the temple!」

0x0032F3.en: 「Oh, don't worry.@ Those are Mechanical Soldiers... unmanned robots that guard the temple.」

0x003358.en: 「Hey, we came here to see old lady Ybun.@ Let us through!」

0x00347F.en: 「Tch, won't hear us out, huh!@ Fine, then we'll smash every last one of you@ and go into the temple ourselves!」

0x003549.en: 「Didn't expect it to turn out like this.@ Just like Masaki said, this Ybun woman@ isn't going to be easy to deal with.」

0x0035E2.en: 「But we can't come all this way@ and go home empty-handed...」

0x00363E.en: 「Well, nothing for it but to fight.@ We'll leave the old lady herself to Lieutenant Irm.」

0x0036D4.en: 「Anyway, let's treat this as a warm-up and dive in!」

0x00371D.en: 「High-speed flying object, approaching! Just one!@ Identification is... we have a data match!」

0x0037C0.en: 「It really is the Hagane! The Cybuster's here too!」

0x003813.en: 「Thank goodness... we finally ran into some familiar faces.」

0x003878.en: 「That's Ibis and the others' new machine.」

0x0038A6.en: 「So those two were summoned to La Gias as well...」

0x0038EC.en: 「Masaki, what in the world is going on...?」

0x003926.en: 「Before that, give us a hand, would you?@ We've gotta beat these things and get into the temple.@ I'll explain everything later.」

0x003A45.en: 「Alright, that's the last of 'em! Now let's get inside!」

0x003A88.en: 「Tch! What's that old hag playing at?!」

0x003AC5.en: 「We've got the edge in mobility, but don't get careless!」

0x003B0E.en: 「I know that!@ Right now, let's focus on getting through this!」

0x003B67.en: 「I'm getting the hang of it! Let's go, Diablo!」

0x003BB3.en: 「Do they have some reason to keep us out of the temple?@ Or are the Mechanical Soldiers just running wild...?」

0x003C36.en: Holy Langran Kingdom, Riot Province - Solates Temple

0x003C95.en: 「So this is where you were hiding, you damn old hag!」

0x003CD6.en: 「Who's there? I told you not to disturb my research...@ Oh, it's you, Masaki.」

0x003D2F.en: 「Don't screw with me!@ Siccing Mechanical Soldiers on us - what's the big idea?!」

0x003D94.en: 「You barge in and that's your first word to me?@ Rude as ever, I see.」

0x003DFC.en: 「Shut it, I came to ask you a favor today.@ You've heard about the recent summonings of surface-dwellers, right?@ The thing is...」

0x003E95.en: 「Is that any way to ask a favor? The nerve of you.」

0x003EDB.en: 「What was that?!@ Give you an inch and you take a mile!」

0x003F34.en: 「...When did I give you an inch?」

0x003FA8.en: 「Stand down, Masaki.@ ...Forgive our sudden intrusion.@ We've come to ask a favor of you.」

0x00404D.en: (She says she's got no confidence, yet here she is taking the plunge.)

0x004093.en: 「...I know. You lot were dragged here from the surface@ against your will, weren't you? And now you want me@ to use my power to send you back.」

0x00416C.en: 「Still, it makes no sense.@ Just who would cast a summoning spell@ on such a scale, and why...?」

0x004205.en: 「Even you, the High Priestess, have no idea?」

0x00424B.en: 「Few can work magic on that scale.@ Aside from me, there's Katechis the Silver Mage,@ or Prince Feil... Prince Terius is a bit too weak.」

0x004320.en: 「Quit being so vague.@ And if you knew why we came, then@ why the hell did you pull a stunt like that?」

0x0043D4.en: 「You mean the Mechanical Soldiers? That wasn't my doing.@ Take your complaints to the REB.@ Not that I expect it to listen.」

0x0044C5.en: 「And to make matters worse, a pseudo-personality's taken hold of it.@ Thanks to that, my research is at a standstill.」

0x00454E.en: 「Besides, I'm getting on in years.@ I can't cast the return spell without the REB backing me up.」

0x004621.en: 「It's the main computer here.@ Seems it got hacked.@ Probably the work of Shutedonias, but...」

0x004709.en: 「Um... does that mean we can't get back to the surface?」

0x004755.en: 「If we erase the pseudo-personality possessing the <REB>,@ we can manage it... but it summoned a Demon Golem,@ so we can't get close.」

0x004805.en: 「If you want me to cast the return spell,@ then destroy that Demon Golem.」

0x004879.en: 「Tch, first Mechanical Soldiers, now a Demon Golem...!」

0x0048BF.en: 「Well, guess we've got no choice but to do it, huh?」

0x0048F9.en: 「Yeah. We can't head back to the surface@ until we find the others, but...@ I'd like to keep an escape route open.」

0x00498C.en: 「Then I'll suppress the pseudo-personality.@ No telling what it'll do loose. Worst case,@ it might blow itself up and take the <REB> too.」

0x004A54.en: 「But I can only hold it for about five minutes.@ In that time, you wipe out the Demon Golem.」

0x004AFF.en: 「I'll find a way to seal it.@ Now then, let's head to the temple's lower levels.」
